# SovRoute

SovRoute — Sovereign Non-Custodial Cross-Rail Settlement Infrastructure (Lightning to Base USDC)

SovRoute is a trust-minimized, non-custodial cross-rail settlement engine enabling direct atomic swaps between Bitcoin Lightning Network and Base L2 USDC. By employing deterministic SHA-256 HTLCs and BOLT11 hold invoices, it allows peer-to-peer settlement without centralized intermediaries, pooled custody, or KYC checkpoints.

## Current Route
Lightning BTC -> Base L2 canonical USDC

## Core Properties
- 100% Non-Custodial (No pooled custody, zero operator hot wallet balance)
- Deterministic Recovery Model (Mathematical refund paths guaranteed via on-chain timelocks)
- Direct-to-Wallet Settlement (Zero KYC checkpoints, peer-to-peer)
- Self-Hosted First (Run alongside Bitcoin Core, LND, and Base RPC)
- Open Source (MIT License)

## Protocol Execution Pipeline
1. User locks satoshis into a BOLT11 Lightning hold invoice using a secret preimage hash.
2. Router escrows canonical USDC into an immutable on-chain smart contract (HtlcErc20) on Base L2 using the identical hashlock.
3. User claims USDC directly to their self-custody wallet by revealing the preimage on-chain.
4. Router captures revealed preimage and settles Lightning satoshis atomically.
5. If claim does not occur within the timelock, mathematical refunds are guaranteed on both rails.
